en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing pavilion‑style exhibition buildings in a landscaped park with paths and flowerbeds, set against low hills. The wooden pavilions have tall, ornate towers and spires. Two women in long skirts and hats walk on a path in the foreground. Red printed Hungarian text appears at the top, and the reverse side has a typical divided‑back postcard layout with Hungarian wording.
